title: Migration Mapping Rules v1.0
description: OPTIONAL operator file projects/{slug}/migration/{date}-mapping-rules.json, validated when present (absence = explicit old_url,new_url pairs from the {date}-url-mapping.csv only). Holds ordered regex redirect rules the migration-map skill expands over the full old-site crawl inventory (R-134); each rule maps an old-URL pattern to a new-URL template with a 301/410 action. Additive standalone schema — no existing schema is touched, no migration (mirrors the GAP-T2 facet-policy.schema.json precedent). See rules/tech-seo-governance.md R-134.

schema_version.description: Schema version this mapping-rules file conforms to (rules/schema-versioning-discipline.md).

rules.description: Ordered regex redirect rules applied (lowest `order` first) to every old URL the explicit pairs did not already map. First match wins.

match.description: Python `re` pattern matched against the old URL (path or absolute). Capture groups feed the `replace` template.

replace.description: New-URL template; `$1`/`$2` (or `\1`) reference `match` capture groups. Empty string is valid for an action:410 rule (no target).

action.description: Disposition for matched URLs: 301 (redirect to the expanded `replace` target) or 410 (gone — no target).

order.description: Application order; rules are applied ascending, first match wins (deterministic, operator-controlled).

defaults.description: Disposition for old URLs that no explicit pair and no rule matched.

unmatched.description: `flag` = list the URL as unmapped for operator triage (never silently dropped, per R-134); `410` = treat every unmatched URL as gone.
